_comment: "Put it into your hero's SOUL" was PUT_SELF_BOTTOM_DECK, which hard-codes the deck. PUT_SELF_IN_ZONE is the same handler reading the zone the card names; the repo's own guard (test_put_self_in_zone) requires that spelling rather than a zone passed to the bottom-deck one. A different zone with different consequences: the card is redrawn instead of fuelling soul-count effects. Found on 4 cards by review, 6 by sweeping every card whose text says "into your soul".
